Then I’ve been investing in land/real estate for a long time, that’s my non degen safe heaven. And finally, community. We all got so lonely. Going back to the basics: dinners at home with friends and family, cooked with your own hands. Community is why the internet was born in the first place. Humans are social animals. We pushed everything too far and went full cyrcle, the loneliest humanity has ever been. It’s been a wild ride, but it’s good that it will all come to an end, to some extent.
